components.name: Constellation AG
components.role: Makes bounded, one-use authorization decisions from current inputs.
components.use: Use when a workflow needs an exact-work authorization boundary.

components.name: Constellation Docket
components.role: Keeps custody of a bounded execution attempt and records its outcome.
components.maturity: Supported executor contracts and an operationally reusable Git-effect vertical; not production-hardened.
components.use: Use when an authorized workflow needs attempt identity and settlement custody.

components.name: Constellation Nightshift
components.role: Tracks currentness, recurrence, and attention over time.
components.maturity: Development evidence exists; no operational-qualification claim.
components.use: Use when a workflow needs temporal observation rather than authorization or execution.

components.name: Constellation NQ
components.role: Derives bounded diagnostic dispositions or typed refusals from retained evidence.
components.maturity: Developer preview with bounded local-VM qualification; no production or estate-wide qualification.
components.availability: Public source at immutable tag constellation-public-source-20260912; no binary package is published.
components.use: Use for source inspection, scoped builds, and the four documented diagnostic profiles—not for a general health or action claim.

components.name: Maude
components.implementation_form: standalone Python authoring and supervision product
components.role: Authors, checks, compares, and locks pre-governed plans.
components.maturity: Public source is available; the reviewed integration/release content is not yet published as a tutorial route.
components.use: Use for source-level Plan Core work; a checked plan grants no permission and runs no work.

components.name: Phosphor
components.implementation_form: read-only inspector hosted in Constellation AG
components.role: Read-only inspection surface hosted with Constellation AG.
components.maturity: Implemented read projection; no standalone package or browser mutation authority.
components.availability: Hosted capability in public AG source
components.use: Use to inspect joined records without changing a plan, authorization, attempt, or settlement.

components.name: Constellation Continuity
components.role: Provides receipted persistence custody for workflows that explicitly rely on retained memory.
components.maturity: Supported in a continuity-aware vertical; broader trajectory doctrine remains candidate.
components.use: Use only when a workflow needs explicit persisted-memory lifecycle records.

components.name: Constellation Standing
components.role: Owns scoped, expiring mandate custody and standing judgments.
components.maturity: Implemented; broader deployment is not claimed.
components.use: Use when a workflow requires an independently custodied mandate lifecycle.

components.name: Constellation Linear Accountant
components.implementation_form: standalone Rust library and thin transport binary
components.role: Accounts for conserved finite capacity separately from action permission.
components.maturity: Frozen v0 reference component with a machine-checked arithmetic core.
components.use: Use when finite capacity must be conserved; it does not grant permission to act.

components.name: Switchyard Runtime
components.role: Provides a reviewed source-only provider-runtime distribution for an enrolled integration.
components.maturity: Public source cut at b33f45d; not a general provider service.
components.use: Use only where a documented integration selects it; it is not a new governance office.

components.name: Wicket
components.implementation_form: standalone Rust admissibility-preflight library and CLI
components.role: Performs stateless admissibility preflight for supplied basis, precedence, and standing.
components.maturity: Public, live with a historical consumer; its relation to AG remains unratified.
components.use: Use for standalone or legacy preflight, not as a replacement for an owning authorization office.

components.name: Constellation Monitor
components.implementation_form: standalone Rust project-concern acquisition workspace hosting Pulse
components.role: Acquires and validates bounded project concerns without establishing diagnostic truth or action authority.
components.maturity: Experimental implementation with one closed NQ/Nightshift support adapter.
components.availability: Private source; no public source link or visibility change is implied.
components.use: Use only in a separately authorized deployment that needs project-concern acquisition or Pulse support.

components.name: Pulse
components.implementation_form: Rust evaluator and support adapter hosted within Monitor
components.role: Evaluates proposition-specific present support under explicit coverage and policy.
components.maturity: Bounded local implementation with proposition-specific qualified integration.
components.availability: Hosted in private Monitor source; no standalone repository or package.
components.use: Use only for named consumer reliance with explicit policy; positive support expires and is not general health.

components.name: Axolotl
components.role: Explores bounded ambiguity interrogation and intent preparation upstream of authorization.
components.availability: No public source or implementation is available.
components.use: Treat as roadmap context, not an installable component or a current workflow prerequisite.
